trigger.runtime_boundary: the E120 diagnostic run advanced from the prior 46-present stop to 66 presents
trigger.source_audit: pinned DXVK a6764047 resets each in-flight descriptor pool on submission completion and then reuses it; the return from vkResetDescriptorPool is ignored
trigger.root_cause: BVB exposed vkResetDescriptorPool as required-unimplemented, so DXVK marked pools reusable without the native reset and eventually exhausted a 1024-set pool

implementation.wire: 16-byte canonical little-endian descriptor-pool ID plus zero flags and reserved word
implementation.client: validates typed same-device ownership, forwards the reset, and retires every child descriptor-set proxy only after VK_SUCCESS
implementation.service: resolves the real Bionic VkDevice/VkDescriptorPool, calls native vkResetDescriptorPool, and retires every child descriptor-set ID only after VK_SUCCESS
implementation.policy: vkResetDescriptorPool promoted from required-unimplemented to executable
implementation.scope: exact DXVK flags=0 whole-pool recycle; vkFreeDescriptorSets remains outside this gate

validation.wire_corruption: reserved bytes and nonzero flags fail closed
validation.cross_process: allocate -> reset -> old client/service set IDs retired -> allocate again from the same pool

reuse: The required deja query returned no indexed implementation. E121 reuses E056 typed descriptor pool/set ownership and the pinned DXVK a6764047 descriptor-pool completion lifecycle; the E120 diagnostic record selects this exact gate.
